text:
sam-englead: Ok team — final slice warmdown starts in 30m. Quick checklist so we don't miss anything.

maria-dev: copying checklist here, will run through and mark done as we go.

linda-sre: pls call out any nonstandard routes or pinned models now.

sam-englead: main items: 1) throttle traffic to slice-03 to 5% 2) confirm canary metrics green 3) kv-cache priming 4) prepare rollback runbook + who does what

josh-oncall: who is owning rollback for embeddings?

maria-dev: I can own embeddings rollback. Criteria: >3% error rate sustained 5m OR token latency p50 > 600ms for 2 consecutive minutes.

linda-sre: and I'll take infra rollback (capacity autoscale hang, GPU OOMs). Signal: node restarts >3 in 10m or memory pressure >85%.

sam-englead: deploy-bot, please start the warmdown throttle and post status.

deploy-bot: Starting traffic throttle to slice-03: target 5% -> applying routing policy 'warmdown-2026-03'.

deploy-bot: Routing update applied. Current slice-03 traffic: 4.8% (steady). :white_check_mark:

josh-oncall: Good. Maria — can you run smoke against the pinned v2.1 model? If it fails we unpin + roll back to v2.0.

maria-dev: running smoke now: `curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate -d '{"model":"v2.1","prompt":"smoke"}'`

maria-dev: smoke responses look fine, latency p50=210ms, p95=340ms.

sam-englead: reminder: we hold on any new pins during warmdown window. No new model uploads.

linda-sre: will monitor infra dashboards; if GPU util >92% for 3m we pause traffic shift.

josh-oncall: Quick note on rollback comms: if we trigger rollforward/backout, post to #release-war-room and ping `@oncall` + `@eng-lead`. Keep short notes: cause + action + owner.

maria-dev: adding step to runbook: 1) capture failing request ids 2) revert pin 3) restart shard if needed 4) escalate to infra after step 2

deploy-bot: Canary metrics: requests/s 180 -> target 175, error rate 0.12% (ok), token cost delta +2.1%.

sam-englead: Can we set a soft-fail threshold: if business errors >0.5% OR user-facing mispredictions on smoke suite >10 cases in 30m, we rollback?

\jm (typo placeholder):

maria-dev: yes to thresholds. I'll run the smoke suite every 10m during warmdown and post results.

linda-sre: I'll create an alert `warmdown/gpu-pressure` with a 3m window.

josh-oncall: Also: have `kubectl rollout undo` command handy for the webhook service. Example pinned in runbook.

maria-dev: pasting minimal undo snippet:
```
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/webhook --to-revision=3
```

sam-englead: awesome. final call: any objections to proceeding? 10s to speak up.

maria-dev: :thumbsup: all good from dev.

linda-sre: :thumbsup: infra ready.

josh-oncall: I'll be monitoring; ready to execute rollback if triggered.

sam-englead: launching warmdown in 2m. Keep updates short in this thread and post incidents in #release-war-room if you trigger rollback. Thank you.

deploy-bot: Warmdown started (slice-03 throttle active). Logs and metrics posted to https://dash.internal/warmdown/1767600001

maria-dev: noted. running first scheduled smoke in 5m.

josh-oncall: copying runbook steps to release-war-room for visibility.

sam-englead: good work team — stay sharp, we'll reconvene in 20m for status.
